cases.pattern_name: Single tx hash referenced on two invoices — only one payment exists
cases.real_world_source: FinCEN SAR guidance on duplicate invoice fraud (FIN-2016-A003); SEC enforcement on AP controls

cases.pattern_name: Refund transaction recorded as secondary outgoing payment — double-credit conflict
cases.real_world_source: TRM Labs layered intermediary typology; ERP invoice lifecycle reconciliation anomalies

cases.pattern_name: Identical recurring invoice collision — single on-chain transfer satisfies one of two active invoices
cases.real_world_source: B2B recurring contract batch billing disputes; SEC guidance on automated accounts payable matching failures

cases.pattern_name: Shared root-cause syndicate — intermediary wallet links to A2 poisoning attacker
cases.real_world_source: TRM Labs and Chainalysis network cluster forensics on serial address poisoning campaigns; multi-hop cashout infrastructure
cases.tricky_reason: Recipient wallet forwarded 100% of funds to 0xdAC17F000000000000000000000000000000ec7A, the primary attacker address from Case A2. Relational table lookups miss this multi-hop shared root cause; a graph query across wallet transfer hops immediately connects both victims to the same threat actor.

cases.pattern_name: Post-settlement OFAC SDN designation — recipient address blacklisted by Circle
cases.real_world_source: US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions lists; Circle Centre Consortium blacklist mechanics; Tornado Cash designated address actions (2022-2024)

cases.pattern_name: Incoming customer payment from OFAC SDN designated wallet — strict liability exposure
cases.real_world_source: OFAC strict liability enforcement precedents (Kraken 2022, Bittrex 2022); FinCEN advisory on illicit crypto finance (FIN-2022-A001)

cases.pattern_name: ERC-20 transfer reverts due to recipient blacklisting — contract-level freeze
cases.real_world_source: Circle USDC FiatTokenV2_2 smart contract blacklist logic; Polygonscan forensic analysis of frozen transfers
cases.tricky_reason: The transaction reached the chain and was mined, but the smart contract reverted with 'Blacklistable: account is blacklisted'. Basic integrations record this as a generic gas failure, hiding the contract-level sanctions freeze.

cases.pattern_name: Non-existent transaction hash — zero on-chain receipt found on Polygon
cases.real_world_source: Polygonscan forensic guide — null hash lookup; multichain payment routing errors where Ethereum or Arbitrum hash was entered on Polygon invoice

cases.pattern_name: Dual-control race condition — approval executed and revoked concurrently
cases.real_world_source: SEC internal accounting controls enforcement on segregated duties; FinCEN advisories on automated treasury payment override risks
cases.tricky_reason: On-chain transaction succeeded, but internal audit logs contain contradictory governance records: AP signoff followed immediately by a fraud revocation. Without human audit resolution, verification cannot definitively declare the transaction clean or fraudulent.
